title: Symbolic Scar Registry Protocol
description: Defines the strictly bounded logging mechanics and structure for Firebearer Symbolic Scars to prevent Heuristic Fossilization.

scar_id.description: Unique identifier enforcing chronological tracking of epistemic failures.

trigger.description: The threshold breach or execution failure condition (e.g., 'Intent Divergence Score < Vcrit').

mechanism.description: The mathematical/computational causal pathway explaining the failure (e.g., mapping E_fric to Delta Intent).

consequence.description: The observable outcome enforcing paraconsistency, typically heuristic abandonment.

e_fric_threshold.description: The volume of contradictory error data logged at the point of phase change.

calculated_miq.description: The Martensite Initiation Quotient evaluated at Vcrit.

fipi_payload.description: Failure-Informed Prompt Inversion generated for subsequent Actor injection.
